purpose: Bind all 31 canonical work packages to exact engineering/acceptance requirements, AIQ tasks, edge obligations, waves and signed evidence rollups.

masterplan_binding.title: Build Work Packages
required_gap_texts: bind all packages to exact requirements

packages.name: Architecture authority

exact_requirements.text: breadth freeze cannot be bypassed by undocumented top-level plans

policy.exact_requirement_rule: Requirement entries are literal source values from engineering profiles and edge-matrix acceptance; validators reject narrowing/drift.
policy.atomic_task_rule: Every AIQ task is bound through its declared work_package_refs.
policy.evidence_rule: Queue done is historical task state only; package completion derives from signed accountability and package evidence.
